pr_title: feat(test-runner): allow non-ascii characters in the output dir path

issue_context.title: [Feature]: Make test result directory name able to include non-ASCII character
issue_context.body:
### Feature request

Hi,
Currently Playwright-test's generated test output directory name is including the test's title, but it can only includes alphanumeric values, all non-ASCII character will be replaced with a hyphen `-`.

My tests title is in Japanese so it would be nice if it can include non-ASCII character in the output folder.
